title: What is not a goal of endodontic therapy?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): removing as much pulp tissue with the least loss of hard tooth structure
endo: removing large amounts of hard tissue that is likely infected with bacteria
midterm: creating a space for adequate irrigation
column5: activating the irrigants via the oacillating handpiece to potentiate their cleansing action.

title: When it comes to cleansing the canals what factor(s) are not directly relevant?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): preservation of as much hard tissue as possible consistent with effective removal of pulp tissue.
endo: the preservation of the quality of the remaining dentin after instrumentation.
midterm: whether or not an instrumentation system produces dentinal microcracks

title: What do we wish to avoid when instrumenting canals?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the creation ledges
endo: transporting the canal in the apical third
midterm: producing dentinal defects

title: When instrumenting canals it is important to think
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): two dimensionally concentrating on the mesio-distal dimensions of the tooth
endo: three dimensionally in both the mesio-distal and bucco-lingual plane of the canals
midterm: about limiting instrumentation in the bucco-lingual plane
column5: about limiting instrumentation primarily to the mesio-distal plane

title: Most canals in posterior teeth are
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): round in cross-section
endo: are wider bucco-lingually than mesio-distally
midterm: are wider mesio-distally than bucco-lingually
column5: are highly oval in the mesio-distal dimension

title: What is an accurate description of an 02 tapered instrumentation system
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): each instrument increases by .2 mm/mm in diameter as we go from the instrument tip coronally
endo: each instrument increases by .02/mm/mm in diameter as we go from the instrument tip coronally
midterm: each instrument increases by .02 mm/2mm as we go from the instrument tip coronally

title: What is the difference between an 02 tapered and 04 tapered instruments with both having a tip diameter of .20 mm?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the 02 tapered instrument will encounter more contact with the canal walls than the 04 tapered instrument.
endo: the 02 tapered instrument will remove more tooth structure than the 04 tapered instrument.
midterm: the 02 tapered instrument will remove less tooth structure than the 04 tapered instrument
column5: the 04 tapered instrument will encounter less resistance when working the canals bucco-lingually.

title: In comparing reamers to files
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): reamers encounter more resistance along the length of the canal walls
endo: files predominantly remove dentin when employing a horizontal hand motion
midterm: reamers predominantly remove dentin when employing a horizontal hand motion

title: What are the differences in design between a stainless steel twisted reamer and a stainless steel twisted file?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): reamers have approximately half the number of flutes along the same 16 mm of working length compared to a file
endo: the orientation of the flutes on a reamer are about twice as vertical as those on a file
midterm: files are stiffer because the extra flutes produced by extra twists work harden the instruments more than reamers

title: How does the 30º oscillating handpiece work?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): It generates a 30º arc that is additive creating a full arc of motion ater 12 cycles producing a 360º.
endo: at 3000-4000 cycles per minute, the 30º oscillating handpiece generates between 250 and 330 rotations per minute
midterm: eliminates all rotations by limiting the arc of motion to 30º

title: The main causes of instrument separation include
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): excessive apical pressure applied to the oscillating instruments
endo: excessive buccal and lingual pressure applied to the oscillating instruments
midterm: excessive mesial and distal pressure applied to the oscillating instruments
column5: excessive torsional stress and cyclic fatigue applied to rotating instruments

title: What instruments are more prone to separation?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): those used in rotation whether continuous or interrupted
endo: those used in 30º oscillations

title: What does Newton's Third Law of Motion state?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): that two bodies that interact will have interactions that are dependent upon the size of each body
endo: that two bodies that interact will produce different results dependent upon the force of the first body on the second
midterm: that two bodies that interact will produce different results dependent upon the force of the second body on the first
column5: that two bodies that interact will have an equal and opposite impact on each other

title: The advantages of room temperature canal obturation does not include:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): no shrinkage and some expansion of the obturation materials
endo: eliminating the use of a cement interphase between the gutta percha point and the canal wall
midterm: the high flowability of the cement interphase that adapts to all the voids that may be present between the gutta percha point and the canal walls
column5: a three dimensional fill achieved often without the need for auxiliary points.

title: What roots are most vulnerable to root perforation due to concavities along their furcal lengths during instrumentation?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): maxillary centrals, laterals and canines
endo: the mesial roots of maxillary and mandibular first molars
midterm: mandibular anteriors
column5: the distal roots of mandibular molars and the palatal roots of maxillary molars

title: The term “internal routing” is applied to
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): all instrumentation systems
endo: particularly to rotary systems both continuous and interrupted
midterm: specifically to 02 tapered stainless steel twisted reamers used in a 30º oscillating handpiece
column5: the manual use of K-files that can be controlled via the amount of hand pressure that is applied at all times.

title: The action of “internal routing” describes the following most completely:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the tooth now adapts to the instrument giving a predictable result time after time
endo: the instrument adapts to the tooth and the unique pulpal configurations that exist in each tooth preserving dentin and maximizing the amount of pulp tissue removed.
midterm: minimum dentin removed while removing more pulp tissue
column5: maximum dentin removed to achieve the removal of the most pulp tissue

title: The flat along the SafeSider reamers has the following advantages:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): makes the instruments more flexible
endo: creates two vertical blades that shave dentin away in both the clockwise and counterclockwise motion generated by the 30º oscillating handpiece
midterm: creates a greater space for irrigants and debris
column5: reduces engagement along length making apical negotiation easier

title: What factor(s) do not effect success rates?
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): missed canals
endo: separated instruments
midterm: loss of length

title: When instrumenting and obturating the length of the canal, our apical point of reference consistent with the highest rate of predictability is
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the apical constriction or minor apical diameter
endo: the apical foramen
midterm: the radiographic apex

title: The only irrigant that actually digests pulp tissue remnants is:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): 17% EDTA
endo: 2% chlorhexadine
midterm: NaOCl

title: The bidirectional spiral does all the following except for:
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): drives the cement apically without driving it over the apex
endo: drives the cement laterally along the length of the canal minus the last 3 mm
midterm: drives the cement to the apex, but not beyond
column5: provides a well coated canal prior to the placement of the prefitted master point

title: The greatest disadvantage of thermoplastic obturation is
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the high cost of these systems
endo: the adaptability to the canal walls
midterm: the heat transferred to the ligament attachment of the tooth to bone

title: Typically, when a canal disappears on an x-ray film as it goes apically it means
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the canal is becoming highly calcified
endo: the canal is ending at that point
midterm: it is splitting at the level of disappearance

title: Doing root canal therapy on older patients is often a greater challenge because
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the canals are often quite calcified making them difficult to find and negotiate
endo: the patients have health issues that make them less resilient
midterm: the visits must often be shorter

title: The color of dentin is often a good clue to where the underlying pulp tissue is because
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the dentin becomes whiter as we approach the correct location of the pulp tissue
endo: the dentin tends to becomes darker as we approach the correct location of the pulp tissue
midterm: the dentin becomes redder and redder as we approach the pulp tissue
column5: as the dentin becomes darker it also becomes softer indicating proximity to the pulp tissue

title: When retreating a tooth endodontically, taking a CBCT is a good idea to see
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): just how extensive any bone loss around the roots is
endo: have any canals been missed in the original treatment
midterm: is there any evidence of internal or external resorption

title: When viewing a tooth with a periapical area
Endodontics Midterm Exam (Spring 2019): the tooth should still be tested for vitality with ice or electric pulp tester
endo: it is automatically assumed that it is non-vital
midterm: may or may not need treatment based on how the patient feels
column5: do a biopsy to determine the true cause of the lesion.

endo: Occlusal trauma
midterm: Bacteria and their byproducts

title: The most common cause of apical periodontitis is:
